title: Can I BEAT Cloister?
summary: iwantcheckmate plays Cloister, an obscure two-player variant on an online variant site in bullet time controls. Each side has eight wazirs; captured pieces become bricks and the captor gains a wazir to drop back onto the board. He wins games by capturing the last wazir and by stalemating the opponent.
rules: Each player starts with 8 wazirs (move/capture exactly one square orthogonally).
When a piece is captured, the capturing piece turns into a brick (immovable blocker) on that square and the capturer gains a wazir in hand (transcript 0:14, 0:26).
On your turn you may either move a wazir or drop a wazir from hand onto an empty square.
Bricks block movement and cannot be captured (inferred).
win_condition: Stalemate the opponent (they have no legal move/drop) or capture the last wazir on the board (transcript 0:17, 1:18).

board.shape_notes: Board size not stated in transcript; no frames. Probably small (e.g. 6x6 or 8x8) - unverified.

setup: 8 wazirs per side; exact placement unknown (likely filling the home rank(s)).
